about: A short-form, feed-first app where sneakers are the content and athletes are the reason they matter. When a player debuts a shoe or a pro races in a new model, resale demand reacts; House of Articles ties that moment to the live price move in one feed.

features.title: The wedge
features.body: “Athlete wore X → its price moved Y%. Here's why, and here's where to buy it.”

features.title: Mobile feed
features.body: A mobile-first vertical feed with 20 screens: home feed, brand pages, shoe detail, cart, profile and the Ledger.

features.title: Desktop dashboard
features.body: Six views: Feed, Market, Calendar, Collections, Watchlist and Ledger.

features.title: Provenance on every price
features.body: Each colorway is tagged verified, estimated or synthetic, so you know where a number came from.

features.title: A real data spine
features.body: 7 brands, 13 sneakers and 13 colorways across basketball, running, HYROX and lifestyle.

features.title: No backend
features.body: Both builds are static with inline data, so they open anywhere.
